pins.name: VDDH
pins.description: IR source supply: tie to VDD next to the sensor

parameters.conditions: Average supply current for periodic measurement (one reading every 5 s, the default continuous mode), VDD = 3.3 V; low power periodic measurement is 3.2 mA typ / 3.5 mA max; peak is 175 mA typ for short pulses

source.location: p. 4, section 2.1 Electrical Specifications, Table 4, IDD periodic measurement row

parts.rating: our choice: holds up the 205 mA peaks of the IR source (the datasheet asks for a low-noise LDO sized for the peaks)

options.name: pullUps
options.description: The I2C pull-ups (once per bus: `false` when another part of the bus has them).

notes: VDD and VDDH joined next to the sensor, on one low-noise supply (an LDO, ripple under 30 mV p-p) good for 205 mA peaks at 3.3 V.
The DNC pads are soldered to floating pads (mechanical), never connected.
support.page: Figure 1 typical application circuit; 2.3 interface specifications

notes: Address 0x62 (fixed). SCD41 (same footprint) adds single-shot low-power measurements.
Reflow once, never wash, keep the white membrane on top intact; keep it away from heat sources (regulators) for its temperature and humidity readings.
The decoupling capacitors are our addition: Sensirion's circuit shows only the pull-ups.
